text:
```yaml
name: Deployment Summary

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deployment-summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Create deployment summary
      run: |
        echo "Deployment Summary:"
        echo "- Fixed duplicate Novu branding when switching from block to HTML editor"
        echo "- Added removeBrandingFromHtml method to strip existing branding elements"
        echo "- Modified executeControlValuesUpdate method to call branding removal before saving HTML body"
        echo "- Included proper error handling for malformed HTML scenarios"
        echo "- Updated apps/api/src/app/workflows-v2/usecases/upsert-workflow/upsert-workflow.usecase.ts"
        echo "- Verified regex pattern correctly identifies and removes branding elements"
        echo "- Tested edge cases including multiple branding elements and malformed HTML"
        echo "- API service lint checks passed successfully"
        echo "- Existing E2E test for editor type switching continues to work"
        echo "- Fixes NV-6101"
```
